name: create_tracked_links
title: Create tracked links

url.description: The full address, starting with https:// or http://

title.description: A name for the link the user will recognise (at most 120 characters)

post_id.description: Any id the user's post goes by, to group its clicks (at most 128 characters)

chat_id.description: The channel (…@newsletter), group (…@g.us) or status@broadcast the link is posted to

name: list_tracked_links
title: List tracked links

q.description: Words in the title or the original address

post_id.description: Only the links of this post

chat_id.description: Only the links posted to this channel, group or status@broadcast

name: get_link_clicks
title: Get link clicks

link.description: The link id (l_…) or its short address

chat_id.description: Clicks of the links posted to this channel, group or status@broadcast

granularity.description: With link: clicks per day (default) or per hour

from.description: Start, as a date or date and time (ISO 8601). Default: the last 30 days (2 days per hour)

to.description: End, as a date or date and time (ISO 8601). Default: now
